title: Short window height is inconsistent when moved between monitors with different DPI scaling
body: ### Preflight Checklist - [x] I have read the [Contributing Guidelines](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for this project. - [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to. - [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success. ### Electron Version 41.1.1 ### What operating system(s) are you using? Windows ### Operating System Version Windows 11 Pro 24H2 ### What arch are you using? x64 ### Last Known Working Electron version _No response_ ### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome? I don't know how to test ### Expected Behavior A `BrowserWindow` created with `height: 40` maintains a 40px-tall window after being moved to a secondary monitor with different DPI scaling. ### Actual Behavior When moving the window from the primary monitor (150% scaling) to the secondary monitor (100% scaling), the window's rendered height increases: extra blank space appears below the content area, which no longer matches the gold background height that we set in css. The extra blank space stays even after moving the window back to the primary monitor. *(See attached GIF)* ### Testcase Gist URL https://gist.github.com/theo-yan/8b872715d193915e3ba67d1cb4c8e8de ### Additional Information ## Monitor setup | Monitor | Position | Resolution | Scaling | |---------|----------|------------|---------| | Primary | Left | 1920 × 1080 | 150% | | Secondary | Right | 1920 × 1080 | 100% | ## Steps to Reproduce 1. Configure two monitors as described above (primary 150%, secondary 100%) 2. Run the attached Electron Fiddle 3. Observe the window on the primary monitor — it renders as a 40px-tall toolbar ✓ 4. Drag the window to the secondary monitor 5. Observe the window becomes taller than 40px, with extra empty space at the bottom ✗ ## Other methods I tried - Calling `win.setSize(800, 40)` from the `moved` event does not resolve the issue. - Calling `win.setShape([{ x: 0, y: 0, width: 800, height: 40 }])` does not resolve the issue.
